adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` handler there is no `req.method` guard, so any method (including GET) can reach `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` after the secret check. `zod.parse(...)` throws on invalid/undefined `req.body`, and `symmetricDecrypt(...)` + `JSON.parse(...)` can also throw; none are caught, so a caller who passes the webhook-secret header but sends malformed input will trigger 500s instead of a controlled 4xx. This is verifiable from the diff (no try/catch and no method check).
